scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:web && npm run build:miniapp
scripts.check:clients: npm run check:web && npm run check:mobile && npm run check:miniapp
scripts.check:web: npm --prefix apps/web run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
scripts.check:mobile: npm --prefix apps/mobile run lint && npm --prefix apps/mobile run typecheck
scripts.setup:clients: npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix apps/mobile install && npm --prefix apps/miniapp install --ignore-scripts
